app.name: PXDict
update.available: A new version of PXDict is ready.
login.title: Sign in
login.forgotAskAdmin: Forgot your password? Ask an administrator to reset it.
login.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
login.name: Name
login.inviteHint: Needed for every sign-up method, including the buttons below.
login.verifyEmailSent: Account created. We sent you an email to verify your address.
login.forgotPrompt: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
login.resetSent: If an account uses this address, a reset link is on its way.
login.magicLinkPrompt: Enter your email address and we will send you a link that signs you in.
login.magicLinkSent: If an account uses this address, a sign-in link is on its way.
login.emailCodePrompt: Enter your email address and we will send you a one-time code.
login.codeSent: If an account uses this address, a code is on its way. Enter it below.
login.totpPrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.backupPrompt: Enter one of your backup codes.
login.providerFailed: Signing in with that provider did not work. Try again or use another method.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can sign in now.
search.label: Word to look up
search.hint: Type a word and press Enter. Press / to jump to the search box from anywhere.
results.skipped: This search mode is not available in: {names}
results.deferred: {name} was not searched because the server is busy.
results.offline: You are offline and this lookup is not saved on this device.
account.title: Account
account.impersonated: An administrator is currently signed in as you.
account.noPasswordHint: Signed up with a provider or a passkey and have no password? Use “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in screen, or ask an administrator.
account.twoFactorHint: Ask for a code from an authenticator app after your password.
account.twoFactorScan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
account.twoFactorQr: QR code for your authenticator app
account.twoFactorOpenApp: Open in an authenticator app on this device
account.twoFactorOn: Two-factor authentication is on. Keep your backup codes somewhere safe.
account.twoFactorRequired: Administrators must turn on two-factor authentication to use admin features.
account.backupCodes: Backup codes (each works once; this is the only time they are shown):
account.passkeysNone: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without a password.
account.revokeOthersNow: Sign out of all other devices
account.signOutHint: Signing out also deletes the words and pictures saved on this device for offline use.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.server: The server had a problem. Please try again later.
error.offline: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
error.codeExpired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
error.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.userExists: An account with this email already exists.
error.emailNotVerified: Verify your email address first: check your inbox.
error.invalidInvite: This invite code is invalid, used or expired.
error.inviteRequired: A valid invite code is required to create an account.
error.registrationClosed: Registration is closed. Ask an administrator for an account.
error.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired.
error.noPassword: This account has no password yet.
error.lastAccount: You cannot remove your only sign-in method.
error.tooManyFavorites: You have saved too many words. Remove some first.
history.title: Search history
history.off: History is turned off: lookups are not recorded. Turn it on in your account settings.
favorites.title: Saved words
favorites.empty: No saved words yet. Use ☆ next to a word in the results to save it.
dicts.title: Dictionaries
dicts.hint: Turn dictionaries on or off, and drag them (or use the arrows) to choose the order of results.
dicts.allOff: Every dictionary is off: lookups find nothing until you turn one on.
proposals.title: Propose a dictionary
proposals.hint: Upload dictionary files you want to share. An administrator checks them before anyone can use them.
proposals.name: Title
proposals.filesHint: One dictionary: the main file (.mdx, .dsl, .ifo, …) with its companions (.mdd, …), styles and images — or a single .zip. Up to {size} in total.
proposals.submitted: Thank you! Your proposal is waiting for review.
proposals.none: You have not proposed a dictionary yet.
proposals.resumeHint: Choose the same files again; the upload continues where it stopped.
proposals.resumeMismatch: These are not the same files (names and sizes must match).
admin.meta.title: Title
admin.dictIdHint: Lower-case letters, digits and “-”; also the folder name.
admin.trustedHint: Only for content you reviewed: scripts in its articles would run with this site's origin.
admin.unavailable: not listed by the dictionary server
error.tooManyProposals: You have too many proposals waiting for review. Wait for a decision or withdraw one.
error.lowDisk: The server is short of space. Try again later.
error.dictIdTaken: A dictionary with this id already exists.
storage.readOnly: The dictionary folder is read-only: original files cannot be deleted here.
storage.catalogUnchecked: The dictionary server could not be asked, so unused indexes are not listed.
storage.dictUsage: Original files {source} · index {index} · enabled by {users} users
storage.planTitle: Preview: nothing has been deleted yet
storage.planIntro: These files would be deleted, {bytes} in total. The preview is valid until {time}.
storage.kind.aux_file: Extra file in a dictionary folder
storage.block.media_not_packed: its media is not packed into the index yet (index it again)
storage.block.unavailable: the dictionary server does not list it
storage.warn.favorites_lost: {count} saved words point at it and are deleted too.
storage.warn.no_reindex: Without the originals the dictionary cannot be indexed again (e.g. after a dictionary server upgrade).
storage.warn.may_be_in_use: This file may still be used (a style sheet, or a dictionary that was not scanned yet).
storage.warn.cancels_upload: This cancels an unfinished proposal upload.
users.banReason: Why is {name} suspended? (optional, shown to them)
users.removeConfirm: Delete the account of {name} ({email}) with their history and saved words? This cannot be undone.
error.planExpired: This preview expired. Preview the deletion again.
error.busy: Something else is being changed right now. Try again in a moment.
